# IISER SmartPrep

> India's premier online preparation platform for the IISER Aptitude Test (IAT) and NEST (National Entrance Screening Test).

## Overview
IISER SmartPrep provides complete, adaptive preparation resources for students targeting the 7 Indian Institutes of Science Education and Research (IISER Pune, Kolkata, Mohali, Bhopal, Thiruvananthapuram, Tirupati, Berhampur), NISER Bhubaneswar, and UM-DAE CEBS Mumbai.

## Core Features
- **Full-Length Mock Tests**: 45+ realistic computer-based tests simulating the exact TCS iON exam environment with complete PCMB coverage.
- **Chapter-Wise Quick Mocks**: 30-minute 16-question timed chapter tests across Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, and Biology.
- **Official PYQ Vault**: Comprehensive previous year question papers (2017–2025) with verified step-by-step solutions and video explanations.
- **Concept Notes & Smart Lessons**: High-yield visual concept notes, formula cheat sheets, and integrated checkpoint quizzes.
- **IAT College Predictor**: Real-time rank and college prediction based on mock scores and official past closing ranks.
- **Adaptive AI Study Planner**: Personalized daily roadmap tracking weak areas, preparation readiness score, and revision schedules.

## Target Examinations
- **IISER Aptitude Test (IAT)**: 60 questions, 240 marks, equal PCMB weightage (15 questions each).
- **National Entrance Screening Test (NEST)**: 4 sections with best-of-3 subject scoring rule for NISER and CEBS.

## Important Links & Documentation

- [Mock Tests Portal](https://iisersmartprep.space/mock_test/full_mock_test_homepage.html): Access full-length and chapter-wise mock tests.
- [Smart Revision Notes](https://iisersmartprep.space/smart_notes.html): Topic-wise concept summaries and formula sheets.
- [PYQ Archive](https://iisersmartprep.space/pyqs/pyq.html): Year-wise and subject-wise official past papers.
- [IISER College Predictor](https://iisersmartprep.space/iiser-iat-college-predictor.html): Calculate admission probability across IISERs.
- [Preparation Guides & News](https://iisersmartprep.space/news-and-announcements.html): Syllabus checklists, weightage analysis, and strategy articles.
- [Terms & Policies](https://iisersmartprep.space/privacy.html): User privacy and terms of service.
